column1: #mapping_set_title: HPO to Cell Ontology links from HPO logical definitions

#mapping_set_description: "478 links from HPO phenotypes to Cell Ontology terms. Direct links: the Cell Ontology term appears in the HPO term's own logical definition. Propagated links, for HPO terms without a direct link: the link of the nearest HPO ancestor is used when the target's label, exact synonym or relational adjective appears as whole words in the phenotype label (case-insensitive, punctuation ignored, plural -s/-es allowed on the last word); only propagated links judged plausible in an automated review are included. predicate_id is the relation directly before the target in the HPO definition, a shorthand for the full relation path given in each comment."
